svg.desc: Composer geometry, permission and mode, workflow rows and model/context metrics. Actual ratatui buffer renders: metrics-narrow, metrics-compact, metrics-startup, workflow-tree, workflow-tree-selected, workflow-tree-clipped, workflow-tree-long
